# Vendored browser assets

`qrcodegen-v1.8.0.js` is the compiled ES6 QR Code generator from Project Nayuki,
version 1.8.0. It is used only in the authenticated Profile page to render a TOTP
enrollment QR code locally in the browser; Pulse does not send the TOTP secret to a
QR-code service.

- Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/releases/tag/v1.8.0
- Upstream file: `qrcodegen-v1.8.0-es6.js`
- SHA-256: `6a1116192ed1dd67fa1bf31e77f5817103d71c23bbac24c382e698b7668bdd01`
- License: MIT; the full copyright and license notice is retained at the top of the JavaScript file.
